independence.expectations: Literal original cues, fixed PCM dimensions, independently written SRT serialization, native media samples and complete file comparisons. No production practice parser or controller supplies expected values.
independence.freeze: Prepare creates a new isolated directory with exclusive file creation, freezes all input expectations and tolerances before execution, invokes only the existing original-PCM seed mode, and saves hashes of the runner, seed helper, metadata and original WAV files. Capture refuses a changed runner or fixture.

nativePlayback.sourceOfObservedTime: Read-only currentTime from the existing native #audio element on requestAnimationFrame and native media events.
checks: Reversed selection stays visible and disables Play once and Repeat without starting native playback.

Two genuine 297..300-second repeat boundaries at 1x. The actual event receipt records pause/seeking/seeked/play/playing transitions; natural pause-before-ended ordering is not independently established by this capacity run.
Each observed previous position is within 150 ms of 300, each landing is within 150 ms of 297, and the observed boundary sample gap is at most 150 ms.
Two boundary landing times are separated by 3000 ± 150 ms without fitting an offset.
Pause remains stationary, Resume advances from that position, and Stop retains its observed position and drops playback.
Switching to Vocals, Backing and Original during active practice leaves the new native source paused.
At 390 px, readiness and focus are checked before trusted keyboard activation; Play once reaches the true song end and does not repeat.
All observed playbackRate values stay at 1, the native loop property remains false, and no media error is observed.

preservation: All 600 raw cue editor field values, title, unapplied paste and Undo/Redo availability remain unchanged.
No mutating HTTP request occurs during practice.
Complete saved metadata, revision and exact server/disk bytes remain unchanged.
Each original WAV is hashed before, after and after fresh-browser reopening, both from served bytes and actual served-library files.
Before and fresh-browser-after SRT bytes match the independent literal-cue serialization exactly.
Before and fresh-browser-after complete archive files compare byte for byte in bounded chunks. The first archive receives independent member, CRC, metadata and all-audio-hash inspection.
Fresh browser means a distinct Chromium process, default 0..0 selection, no resumed practice, and exact saved data reopening.
artifacts: fixture-receipt.json and frozen-expectations.json in the new fixture directory
verification.json retaining partial native observations on failure

commands.rootOwnedService: Root separately starts the existing tests/srt_smoke_server.py --serve /workspace/karaoke125-practice-fixtures/library --port PORT using the built production app, and retains ownership of its PID.

costEstimate.wallTime: Author estimate was approximately 1–2 minutes excluding build and service startup. Actual first root capture completed in 22.655782917 seconds.
costEstimate.network: Only the root-supplied explicit 127.0.0.1 service; no external HTTP requests, inference or model download.
costEstimate.serviceControl: None: runner owns and closes only its own browser processes.

limits: This is full-capacity late-range practice acceptance, not another 300-second full-song playback or video-export run.
No physical-device, audible-output quality, separation accuracy or worst-case memory claim.
The root-owned production service remains running throughout both browser processes; a service restart is not claimed or required for transient practice state.
Root executed the first prepare/capture acceptance; this receipt does not independently claim build, lint, syntax or unrelated suite results.

No native ended event was recorded in the observed repeat or Play once event sequences. The player reached currentTime 300, and the final Play once state was paused=true and ended=true. Separate event-ordering tests are needed for the natural pause-before-ended path.

This accepted capacity run applies to the listed source hashes. Subsequent control-label and visibility corrections are outside this captured build; the original report is retained without assigning its result to changed source.
The author did not visually inspect the screenshots; root owns visual review. PNG dimensions and file hashes are recorded here.

preservation.archiveInspection: Independent first-archive member/CRC/metadata/audio verification; full second-archive byte equality extends that validation to the fresh-browser result.

requests.scope: One archive POST before practice and one after reopening generate the compared backups. There are zero mutating HTTP requests during practice itself.
